text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was walking through the 
park with Winning Ticket on our way back 
from training. Then—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Look ouuuuut!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Caught it!! Whew~ that was close! Wait, 
why a soccer ball all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!! It flew way farther than I 
expected...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Are you hurt at all?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! It's Royceee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...She was having trouble because no 
matter how much she practiced, she just 
couldn't get better."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So!! I thought things would surely go well 
if I produced it, which is why I was 
helping out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yoou're sooo kiiind~~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Got ittt!! I'll help out with all my might 
tooooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! In that case... 
Ticket-san, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This girl has raw talent. What she needs 
now is confidence. Perhaps we should 
intentionally let her win here—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm giving this everything I've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I believe there are things you can only 
gain when both sides clash with everything 
they've got!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you! Dribbling showdown!! Try and 
take the ball from me!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: !? Ticket-san. That ball is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No... regardless, let's chase after 
Ticket-san for now.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I can't... do this 
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's not impossible! Watch their movements 
closely! You can do it! Don't give up!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, keep your eyes on the ball! 
Anticipate where it's going next!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: ! Next... Next is—

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Right here!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: I got it...!? Yes, woohooーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: YOU DID SO GOOOOOD, DAAARLIIING!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"You beat me when I was going all out... 
You're strong! I'm sure you can get really 
good at soccer!!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ......Regarding that matter...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? What you want to get better at is 
basebaaaall!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She was having trouble hitting the 
ball with the bat, so I thought having her 
hit a bigger ball might boost her 
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sooorryyy~! I jumped to 
conclusionnnssss!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Don't apologize! Thanks to you, Big Sis, I 
learned how important it is to give it my 
all!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm going to try my hardest 
at baseball practice too!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"Even if things don't go well right now, 
as long as you keep giving it your all, 
the results will follow..."

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Yes, because I've come to believe it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Thank you sooooo much--!! I'll make 
sure to live up to everyone's feelings 
tooooo--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... Well then, shall we get 
started... on baseball practice!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna throw it with everything I've 
got, so Trainer, please be my catcher!!"

While asking Winning Ticket to go easy on 
them, the boy and I challenged her blazing 
fastballs.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm so glaaaaad... So so glaaaaad~~!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm really giving it my all, should I 
be crying too...?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I don't think you need to force 
yourself to cry, you know? Just do your 
very best, in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... I used to be just as serious 
about everything as you are...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta try even harder too~! Thanks to 
you, I remembered how I felt when I first 
started~~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your earnest dedication was quite 
inspiring. I will make good use of it in 
my future endeavors.
